name: hero-carousel
description: Full-bleed autoplaying photo carousel at the top of a page (prev/next arrows + dots).

view.name: HeroCarousel
view.notes: Starts under the fixed 80px header. Slide height 648px (fischer) / 540px (fischertechnik) via theme preset var --hero-h; below it a ~60px strip with centered dots (12px round, gap 12, inactive var(--color-muted), active var(--color-primary)). Arrows: 44x44 white squares pair, bottom-right overlapping the image bottom edge (right ~122px), black arrow icon, hover icon primary + shadow 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.1). With brand_box theme (fischer) each slide's text box is the red panel at top-left.

interaction.evidence: fischer#1: Splide, 5 rendered slides, arrows + 5 dots, autoplay; fischertechnik#1: Splide loop, 4 slides, arrows + 4 dots, autoplay (frames 0/1 show different slides)
